meaning.en: Growing, cultivated, or living in fields or open land.
meaning.vi: Trồng trọt, canh tác, hoặc sống trên đồng ruộng hoặc bãi đất trống.

meaning.en: Working, operating, or active in the field.

meaning.en: ​A course of study or domain of knowledge or practice. 2013 May 10, Audrey Garric, “Urban canopies let nature bloom”, The Guardian Weekly, volume 188, number 22, page 30. As towns continue to grow, replanting vegetation has become a form of urban utopia and green roofs are spreading fast. Last year 1m square metres of plant-covered roofing was built in France, as much as in the US, and 10 times more than in Germany, the pioneer in this field.

sentences.vi: Nicholas đứng trên cánh đồng hoang có thể nhìn thấy tất cả những vết roi của anh ta.

sentences.en: It's about halfway down the east side of the field in the next-to-last row.

sentences.en: They played with the lambs in the field and saw no human being but the shepherd.

sentences.en: Oh, would that men would leave the city, its splendour and its tumult and its gold, and return to wood and field and simple, honest living!
sentences.vi: Ồ, phải chăng những người đàn ông sẽ rời bỏ thành phố, sự huy hoàng và náo động và vàng của nó, trở về rừng và cánh đồng và sống giản dị, lương thiện!

sentences.en: Any of us in the field receive it, he said and held up his iPhone.

sentences.en: As she walked across the field, a deer came bounding out of the forest on the hill.
sentences.vi: Khi cô đi ngang qua cánh đồng, một con nai chạy ra khỏi khu rừng trên đồi.

sentences.en: That's not my field but I'm not sure if anyone is producing serious study.
